title: PLEASE
statementMd:
As we all know Barney's job is "PLEASE" and he has not much to do at work. That's why he started playing "cups and key". In this game there are three identical cups arranged in a line from left to right. Initially key to Barney's heart is under the middle cup.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dde9cfdbc87f629f0f0e27e9ab4aac6186353065.png)

Then at one turn Barney swaps the cup in the middle with any of other two cups randomly (he choses each with equal probability), so the chosen cup becomes the middle one. Game lasts $*n*$ turns and Barney **independently choses** a cup to swap with the middle one within each turn, and the key always remains in the cup it was at the start.

After $*n*$-th turn Barney asks a girl to guess which cup contains the key. The girl points to the middle one but Barney was distracted while making turns and doesn't know if the key is under the middle cup. That's why he asked you to tell him the probability that girl guessed right.

Number $*n*$ of game turns can be extremely large, that's why Barney did not give it to you. Instead he gave you an array $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ such that

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b18d2cf1466ee2dc63e9b5b814e7441b47986ef.png)

in other words, $*n*$ is multiplication of all elements of the given array.

Because of precision difficulties, Barney asked you to tell him the answer as an irreducible fraction. In other words you need to find it as a fraction $*p* / *q*$ such that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c28de83ec0db3b458a2bc4727afe56b38ff5a346.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f35bbc2586102b2f94133a8461976bd1b6f93dc.png) is the greatest common divisor. Since $*p*$ and $*q*$ can be extremely large, you only need to find the remainders of dividing each of them by $10^{9} + 7$.

Please note that we want ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f35bbc2586102b2f94133a8461976bd1b6f93dc.png) of $*p*$ and $*q*$ to be $1$, **not ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f35bbc2586102b2f94133a8461976bd1b6f93dc.png) of their remainders** after dividing by $10^{9} + 7$.

## Input

The first line of input contains a single integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of elements in array Barney gave you.

The second line contains $*k*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{18}$) — the elements of the array.

## Output

In the only line of output print a single string $*x* / *y*$ where $*x*$ is the remainder of dividing $*p*$ by $10^{9} + 7$ and $*y*$ is the remainder of dividing $*q*$ by $10^{9} + 7$.
statementZhMd:
众所周知，Barney 的工作是“PLEASE”，而且他在工作时没有太多事情可做。因此，他开始玩“杯子和钥匙”游戏。在这个游戏中，有三个完全相同的杯子从左到右排成一行。最初，Barney 心中的钥匙在中间的杯子下面。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dde9cfdbc87f629f0f0e27e9ab4aac6186353065.png)

接下来，每一轮 Barney 都会将中间的杯子与另外两个杯子中的任意一个随机交换（选择两个杯子的概率相同），于是被选中的杯子会成为中间的杯子。游戏持续 $*n*$ 轮，并且 Barney **会在每一轮中独立地选择**一个杯子与中间的杯子交换，而钥匙始终留在每轮开始时所在的杯子中。

在第 $*n*$ 轮结束后，Barney 请一个女孩猜测哪个杯子里有钥匙。女孩指向了中间的杯子，但 Barney 在操作过程中分心了，不知道钥匙是否在中间的杯子下面。因此，他请你告诉他女孩猜对的概率。

游戏轮数 $*n*$ 可能非常大，这就是 Barney 没有直接告诉你的原因。相反，他给了你一个数组 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$，满足

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b18d2cf1466ee2dc63e9b5b814e7441b47986ef.png)

换句话说，$*n*$ 等于给定数组中所有元素的乘积。

由于精度问题，Barney 要求你以最简分数的形式告诉他答案。换句话说，你需要将答案表示为分数 $*p* / *q*$，满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c28de83ec0db3b458a2bc4727afe56b38ff5a346.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f35bbc2586102b2f94133a8461976bd1b6f93dc.png) 表示最大公约数。由于 $*p*$ 和 $*q*$ 可能非常大，你只需要分别求出它们除以 $10^{9} + 7$ 所得的余数。

请注意，我们要求 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f35bbc2586102b2f94133a8461976bd1b6f93dc.png)（即 $*p*$ 和 $*q*$ 的最大公约数）为 $1$，**而不是要求它们除以 $10^{9} + 7$ 后所得余数的最大公约数为 $1$**。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5}$）——数组中元素的个数。

第二行包含 $*k*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{18}$）——数组中的元素。

## 输出格式

输出一行一个字符串 $*x* / *y*$，其中 $*x*$ 是 $*p*$ 除以 $10^{9} + 7$ 所得的余数，$*y*$ 是 $*q*$ 除以 $10^{9} + 7$ 所得的余数。
